previous.changeLog:
- Updated Dynamic Playlists
- Updated Camo Selector (fixed enemy vehicles incorrectly inheriting the player’s locally saved custom outfit for the same tank type. Custom outfits now apply only to the player’s own vehicle during battle)
- Updated Anime Music: Vinyl Edition, Spring Edition, Summer Edition, Autumn Edition, Winter Edition and Farewell Edition; restored Anime The Steel Maiden Edition
- Updated Scheduled Personal Reserves 2.0.1 (improved scheduled booster visibility. Fixed an issue where standard and premium booster variants could be mismatched when scheduling or highlighting them)
- Updated Armor Penetration Calculator (added a kill chance label; changed default colors to be more vibrant)
- Added Anime Tech-Tree icons and Anime Tank Carousel icons by NyanDora_Mech_Tank
- Added Research Progress Bar (by 14th_ua) [mod #1083]

current.changeLog:
- Updated enhanced modsSettingsApi 1.6.0 (a toolbar switch spreads the mods across up to 4 columns; mods can flag their newly added options with a red flare and a counter on the mod's title, like the game's own Settings; new options for mod authors)
- Updated champi.settingsgui_1.72 (dependecy used in CHAMPi mods)
- Updated Show Vehicle 2.0.6 (fixed the hotkey on dual-gun tanks; fixed the tank exclusion list to match exact names; added multi-column settings layout)
- Updated BalCalcMod 2.3.8 (fixed the aim-point correction option; minor fixes)
- Updated Crew Skills Pro 1.0.4 , Hitmarker Pro 1.0.5, AutoAim Indication+ 2.0.8 and Custom Sixth Sense 1.0.8 (added multi-column settings layout)
- Updated Research Progress Bar by Zanju 1.2
